annotations.title: Get Agentic Base USDC Payment Intent (HTTP 402 / x402)

description: Retrieve the machine-readable HTTP 402 / x402 Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453) USDC payment intent for an unpaid job_id so an autonomous AI wallet (Coinbase AgentKit, OpenClaw, or EVM signer) can settle directly on-chain without a browser. Call this tool after calligraphy_compile_board when settling via the canonical x402 Base USDC treasury flow. Requires job_id (string). Returns JSON with chain ('base'), chain_id (8453), token ('USDC'), token_contract ('0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913'), recipient_wallet ('0x0119f2F064669593d95bfA7C340d05E2386f8b03'), exact_amount_usdc, amount_base_units (6 decimals), and erc681_uri.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier (returned by calligraphy_compile_board) requiring HTTP 402 / x402 Base USDC settlement. Example: 'job_01'.
